PNJ-01.secta: Camarilla (out of personal loyalty to the Prince)
PNJ-01.ambicion: For Seattle to outlive its Prince.
convicciones: The Beast does not rule: it is mastered
No lawless monster deserves the gift of the night

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: A Snohomish veterinarian who looks after his dogs and makes him coffee he never drinks.

ventajas: Status 4 (Camarilla): respected Sheriff of the domain (earlier source, doc 22)
Haven 3 (farm in the Snohomish Valley, with a tunnel to a boat landing; LUG-02)
Herd 2 (the bounty hunters, MEN-03)
Contacts 3 (state police, the port, and security firms)
Ally 3 (David Smith, PJ-01)
Mask 2 (retired private security consultant and working-dog breeder)
defectos: Predator's instinct (frenzy test when he smells fresh human blood, Difficulty 2)
Distrust of neonates (−1 die on Social tests with Kindred under 50 years old)
PNJ-01.cita: “I am the guardian between the Beast and the city. If one wakes, the other falls.”
PNJ-01.semblante: Heavyset, weathered skin, a short salt-and-pepper beard, and huge hands; flannel, a waxed jacket, boots; amber eyes under strain.
provisional: David came to Seattle in the '80s (per the whisper “Montgomery and the Hound have been lovers since the seventies”)

PNJ-16.sire: A nameless Malkavian who used to call in from Fremont
PNJ-16.ambicion: To decipher what the city is trying to tell him.
convicciones: Never interrupt someone who is telling the truth
ventajas: Haven 2 (abandoned radio studio on the top floor of a Fremont building)
Herd 1 (the listeners: a dozen insomniacs)
Resources 1 (police, port, and emergency scanners)
Fame 1 (old radio listeners still recognize his voice)
Mask 1 (late-night host at a community radio station)
defectos: Derangement (Malkavian): he can't leave a sentence unfinished. If someone interrupts him, he repeats what he was saying from the beginning.
PNJ-16.cita: “You're not crazy, Helen. And the rain has ears.”
PNJ-16.semblante: Looks about thirty-three. Thin, a scruffy beard, thick-framed glasses, corduroy, and a cap from a team that no longer exists; headphones around his neck and a radio voice.
PNJ-16.nota: Editor's Note: doc 06 said “looks about fifty-five” and “white beard”; the decision was to use his age at the Embrace (about 33, no gray in his beard). Doc 06 gave him “Mask 1 (eccentric Fremont retiree)”; the decision was that his Mask is a late-night host at a community radio station.

PNJ-13.ambicion: For no one to be able to rule Seattle without going through what lies below.
convicciones: What is buried is not lost

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: A shelter worker in Pioneer Square who leaves the back door open for “the ones below” and never asks questions.

ventajas: Haven 4 (the Sealed Underground, beneath Pioneer Square; LUG-04)
Influence 3 (the underground: the Undermarket)
Allies 2 (the thin-bloods: a dozen young ones who gather information on the surface)
Contacts 4 (cops, doormen, night cleaning staff, and maintenance techs all over the city)
Mask 0 (he has no mortal Mask)
PNJ-13.cita: “Everything's for sale below. The only thing that changes is who pays.”
PNJ-13.semblante: Huge and hunched, skin like cracked, wet gray wood, a twisted jaw, and fingers like roots; a patched three-piece suit and a carbide lamp.

PNJ-14.concepto: Keeper of Elysium and Toreador Primogen
PNJ-14.sire: A Toreador from Montreal, since destroyed
PNJ-14.ambicion: For Seattle's record to reach the twenty-second century intact.
convicciones: What is written is not erased

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: A glassblower who makes the Gallery's jellyfish and believes he works for an eccentric foundation.

ventajas: Haven 2 (apartment above the archive of the Glass Gallery)
Allies 2 (the Gallery staff: five ghouls who serve Elysium)
Status 3 (Camarilla)
Mask 2 (director of the Gallery foundation's archive)
PNJ-14.cita: “I don't judge. I record. Time does the judging, and time always reads my books.”
PNJ-14.semblante: Looks about twenty-eight. Tall, dark hair in a low bun, old-fashioned dresses in grays, and glasses on a chain; she writes with a fountain pen.
PNJ-14.nota: Editor's Note: doc 06 said “looks about forty”; the decision was to use her age at the Embrace (about 28).

PNJ-02.sire: Clémence Aubert, a soprano with the San Francisco Opera
PNJ-02.ambicion: For his reign to be remembered as a golden age.

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: 81, a former dancer whose scholarship he funded in the '60s and who now lives in a nursing home. He still sends her flowers.

ventajas: Haven 4 (Capitol Hill penthouse in the name of his cultural foundation)
Resources 4 (the cultural foundation)
Influence 3 (arts and culture)
Status 5 (Camarilla)
Herd 2 (Club Cinder's loyal crowd)
Mask 3 (Marcus Whitmore III, philanthropist, with a fictitious family line that is renewed every forty years)
PNJ-02.cita: “A Prince doesn't rule. He chooses who rules in his name, and applauds.”
PNJ-02.semblante: Looks about thirty-three. Tall, hair slicked back with no gray, very pale gray eyes; an impeccable suit with no tie and a ring with a black stone.
PNJ-02.nota: Editor's Note: doc 06 said “looks about forty-five” and “silver hair”; the decision was to use his age at the Embrace (about 33, no gray). Doc 06 gave him six powers with Presence 5; Daunt was removed (one per dot).

PNJ-15.concepto: Regent of the Observatory Chantry and Tremere Primogen
PNJ-15.sire: Regent Friedrich Ahlers of Vienna (destroyed in 1945)
PNJ-15.ambicion: For the Seattle Camarilla to survive the age of data.

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: An epidemiology PhD candidate whose dissertation she advises by email without him knowing who she is.

ventajas: Haven 3 (the Observatory Chantry in Queen Anne, with blood sorcery wards; LUG-13)
Resources 3 (the dome's servers)
Contacts 2 (technology)
Influence 2 (the university, through the research lab)
Mask 2 (Dr. A. Voight, director of a private computational epidemiology lab)
PNJ-15.cita: “An epidemic never starts with the first death. It starts with the first data point nobody wanted to look at.”
PNJ-15.semblante: Looks about thirty-three. Petite, very short hair in its natural color, rimless glasses, a black turtleneck, and a lab coat; Viennese accent.
PNJ-15.nota: Editor's Note: doc 06 said “looks about fifty” and “white hair”; the decision was to use her age at the Embrace (about 33, hair in its natural color).

convicciones: Order is a service, not a privilege
Never let them see you get your hands dirty

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: His 22-year-old grandniece, a journalism student, who believes her great-uncle is the anonymous benefactor behind her scholarship.

ventajas: Haven 4 (Halloway Tower, with a penthouse and a vault; LUG-06)
Ally 3 (Preston Gale, PNJ-19)
Resources 5 (Halloway Meridian Capital)
Influence 4 (finance and media)
Contacts 3 (the press, city hall, and a state senator's office)
Mask 3 (Charles Halloway Jr., reclusive chairman of an investment fund)
PNJ-03.cita: “This city doesn't need a Prince who looks. It needs one who sees.”
PNJ-03.semblante: Slim, medium height, black hair parted on the side, and tired brown eyes; a classic dark suit, white shirt, and thin tie.
PNJ-03.nota: Editor's Note: doc 06 gave him five powers with Dominate 4 and three with Fortitude 2; Cloud Memory (Forgetful Mind covers it) and Resilience (his Health 6 doesn't include it) were removed, one per dot.
